notes.title: Stellar Echoes Daily fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our Stellar Echoes has been online for a few days, and we have found a lot of problems, we have timely updates and optimizations every day, because the team currently has limited testing equipment, can not adapt to all VR brand devices, it is inevitable to encounter some game experience differences due to different devices, please understand, after we find the problem, it will be fixed in time, thank you.
* Start navigation bar experience optimization
* Fixed an issue where the volume option could not be modified
* Weapon guidance, story menu guidance optimization
*The difficulty of the third chapter maze part has been reduced
* Optimized some terrain jitter issues
* Model optimization
* The background music of the third chapter maze part is optimized

notes.title: 2023 Lantern Festival Update
notes.content:
The fifteenth day of the first lunar month is the traditional Chinese festival, the Lantern Festival, also known as the Shangyuan Festivall. Dragon lantern dancing is one of the main festival activities. At the arrival of the Lantern Festival, we made a small interaction of dragon lantern dancing, hoping to bring you the joy of the festival.
